name: Kaldvik AS
summary: Kaldvik AS is an Icelandic enterprise primarily engaged in the cultivation of salmon. In addition to its main aquaculture operations, the company manages facilities specifically for raising smolt. Established in 2020, Kaldvik AS maintains its headquarters in Eskifjörður, Iceland. The firm officially transitioned its name from Ice Fish Farm AS to Kaldvik AS in August 2024, and it operates as a subsidiary entity of Austur Holding As.
